scope: Deadline calculation architecture for Irish property-related procedures and disputes. It does not calculate an individual deadline without the governing provision and trigger facts.
official_source_basis: Applicable property legislation and statutory instruments
verified_points: Interpretation Act 2005 section 18(h) contains general inclusion rules for periods expressed to begin/end on or from a particular day, subject to the governing enactment.
The Interpretation Act 2005 Schedule defines calendar month, week, week-day, public holiday and working day.
Interpretation Act 2005 section 16 contains general commencement rules for Acts and statutory instruments, subject to its exceptions.
core_rule: TRIGGER → PROVISION → TIME UNIT → COUNTING RULE → EXCLUSIONS → EXTENSIONS → CALCULATION → VALIDATION
critical_boundary: The general Interpretation Act rules do not replace a specific deadline rule in the governing legislation or court rules.
